EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS

Claimant:


Miss Angela Durrant


Respondent:
Safeguard Security NE Ltd




Heard at:
Newcastle by CVP


On: 13 March 2026

Before:
Employment Judge Moss

Appearances
For the claimant:
In person
For the respondent: Miss Erin Bright (Litigation Consultant)


JUDGMENT


1. The claimant's complaint of unfair dismissal is dismissed pursuant to Rule
28 of The Employment Tribunal Procedure Rules 2024 because the tribunal
has no jurisdiction to consider the claim due to the claimant not having had 2
years' continuous employment with the respondent, as required by s108(1)
of the Employment Rights Act 1996.





Employment Judge Moss

15 March 2026"}]}
